name: web-brutalist-architecture-site-in-greyscale-with-vertical-title-and-stat-cards
title: Greyscale architecture site with a giant vertical 'BRUTALISM', concrete building photos, glass stat cards and boxed layout
whatItIs: A charcoal-and-grey boxed layout: a left column with the studio name and nav, a tall black-and-white photo of blocky concrete houses, a huge vertical 'BRUTALISM' with '01' in dark type on a mid-grey column, a copyright block with a second photo, three frosted stat cards (14, 120,000, 5) with line icons in monospace, bottom links and a large 'Axis' with a ruler and tagline.
whatItMeans: Stark and architectural; a modular boxed grid and giant rotated type mirror concrete forms.
techniques: Use a giant rotated word as a column.
Divide the page into boxed panels.
Use frosted stat cards with monospace numbers.
Keep everything black, white and grey.

vocabulary.definition: A page divided into visible rectangular panels.
A rotated giant word filling a column.
A translucent card with a figure.
